purpose: Bounded public development headroom check, not a held-out evaluation or model ranking
stopping_rule: Exactly four public development episodes; one attempt each; no added seeds, retries, timeout changes or replacement failures
interpretation: Completed task failures may suggest headroom; transport failures remain unknown about ability. All-success or all-failure at either extreme motivates a future separately versioned calibration, not retuning these samples. No readiness or ranking claim from one seed.
